alt: A coil of insulated wire wound round a soft iron core, connected to a cell through a switch, attracting iron clips. Notes explain the insulation, the soft iron core, and that more turns and a larger current make it stronger.
caption: Insulated coil plus soft iron core: a magnet that switches on and off with the current.

alt: A horizontal wire carries current from west to east between magnet poles, with the field pointing horizontally from north to south. By the left-hand rule the force on the wire is vertically downwards; reversing current or field makes it upwards.
caption: Field south, current east: the thumb, and the force, point straight down.
